title: M3.2 AI Kit Factory implementation
purpose: Implement the accepted minimal AI Kit Factory: direct source reading by an author AI, deterministic source/brief/kit binding and structural gates, independent semantic-review contract, and deterministic final PASS/HOLD evidence.
invariants: M3.2 is AI Kit Factory, not Source-to-Draft.
Source files are treated as opaque bytes by deterministic factory code; no extraction/OCR/normalization subsystem is introduced.
Canonical validators and the M3.1 pedagogical-quality engine remain read-only upstream authorities.
Factory structural eligibility requires M3.1 STRONG or EXCELLENT_BY_PROFILE.
COMPLETE is HOLD; advice may remain at STRONG to avoid metric gaming or source distortion.
Semantic review requires exactly six dimensions and exact source/brief/kit context binding.
Reviewer independence declarations require no author scratchpad and no active author context reuse.
Any blocking/major semantic finding prevents PASS.
Factory gate is deterministic, read-only and network-free.
No model/vendor API, backend, Studio change, learner-runtime change or automatic publication is introduced.
requiredEvidence: Context output deterministic and source-order independent.
Host source paths absent from evidence.
One-byte source/kit change and semantic brief change invalidate a previous review.
M3.1 COMPLETE candidate cannot factory PASS.
STRONG/EXCELLENT with valid independent semantic review can PASS.
Missing dimension, unknown source evidence and malformed brief fail closed.
Independence violation, dimension HOLD or blocking/major finding causes semantic HOLD.
Minor/advice semantic findings may remain non-blocking.
CLI inputs remain byte-identical and factory code has no network/write primitive.
Author V2 and reviewer V1 skills encode the accepted separation.
Learner regressions and exact learner artifact identity PASS.
Independent QA binds one exact frozen product HEAD.
adversarialTests: Stale semantic review after kit byte drift.
Stale semantic review after source byte drift.
Stale semantic review after learner-brief semantic change.
Positive semantic report over canonical-invalid kit.
Positive semantic report over M3.1 COMPLETE kit.
PASS semantic verdict with blocking/major finding.
Malformed learner brief or source specification.
Any network/write primitive in factory gate.
Any product change outside exact allowlist.
independentReview: Accepted design was challenged under Linus/Steve/pedagogy perspectives.
Repository governance and PR scope gate the product PR.
QA-WP-022 uses disjoint QA-only paths and is non-repairing.
At least two real-source qualification runs are required before promotion.
rollback: Remove the additive factory gate, V2 author/reviewer skills, tests/workflow and work-package metadata. M3.1, Studio, learner runtime and stored data remain unchanged.
